item.title: Bollards and tape blocking the highway and pavement., 12th October
item.description:
I have previously reported this obstruction 9 times. The builders at white gates are over putting the highway and pavement with bollards and tape outside 70/72 Lubbock Road. I have previously sent you 10 photos of the obstructions complained of over a period of 12 days. The obstruction is on a daily basis. Also today the builders vans are partially obstructing my driveway. I am unsighted as I leave my driveway. The builders are rude to me if I ask them to adopt courteous parking. Please can you address this. There is going to be an accident unless some order is brought to the parking. It’s a very fast stretch of road particularly with cars turning in from Old Hill. I personally have a near miss with another vehicle each day.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 74, Lubbock Road, Elmstead, Greater London

item.title: Huge amount of cardboard fly tipped in Penge east car oark, 12th October
item.description:
This is a persistent problem that the council is not sorting from the root. Your code states that you need to keep an area which is heavily used clean. This site has not been cleaned for few days and it is used by pedestrians all the time. This is causing a slipping hazard as well as all other health and safety hazard given the rats that are around. The council has to reconsider whether these bins should be left here at all. The council by putting these bins here is contributing to flytipping as well and probably should fine itself for that! One of the green recycling banks was clearly on fire and has burst in the bottom. It is near an electricity room and near a nursery! Please send your contractor to clear this mess and letter before action will be sent to your legal department soon.

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Station Road, Penge, Greater London
Report on FixMyStreet
